title: BENOFTHEWEEK’s DRAMA MAMA Podcast Joins SiriusXM
summary: The hit comedy and culture podcast from Benjamin De Almeida joins SiriusXM’s growing podcast slate.
body_markdown:
*DRAMA MAMA* , BENOFTHEWEEK’s hit comedy and culture podcast, is joining SiriusXM.


SiriusXM and the Emmy-nominated and Webby Award-winning creator Benjamin De Almeida, better known as BENOFTHEWEEK, announced a new partnership bringing the comedy and cultural-commentary podcast to the SiriusXM Podcast Network beginning October 1.


Under the agreement, SiriusXM will handle global distribution and ad sales for *DRAMA MAMA,* while the show will be available on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogDramaMamaBenOfTheWeek) and across major podcast platforms, including[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@dramamamapodcast) , where it has built a subscriber base of nearly 1 million.


[DRAMA MAMA Podcast by BENOFTHEWEEK Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogDramaMamaBenOfTheWeek)


### About *DRAMA MAMA*


With more than 200 episodes and five years of weekly programming, *DRAMA MAMA* features De Almeida’s unfiltered takes on the internet, pop culture, celebrities, memes, and the absurdities of modern life.


The video-first series combines comedy and cultural commentary with De Almeida’s distinctive style and perspective, giving fans his take on the fast-moving conversations shaping internet culture.


The partnership marks the latest expansion of De Almeida’s entertainment brand. The creator has amassed more than 21 million followers across platforms through content spanning comedy, entertainment, and culture.


### BENOFTHEWEEK Expands Beyond Social Media


Beyond *DRAMA MAMA* , De Almeida has worked with brands including Google, Coachella, Paramount/Nickelodeon, Dior, and Prada, and has been featured by outlets including *ELLE* , *WWD* , *PAPER* , *The New York Times* , *Vogue* , and *GQ* .


He has also expanded into traditional entertainment, including a voiceover role in the *Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles* animated series.
